item.description:
**Fieldbook 2.4.6 beta 1** (a beta)
### Added - **Settings › Languages:** what meetings are spoken in (eleven languages, or Detect automatically), what notes and the follow-up email are written in, and whether Help Me Answer spots questions in every language. English throughout until you change it. - **A folder's language:** right-click a customer or label › **Language**; listed in Settings › Languages. - **A meeting's language:** the 🌐 menu in the meeting header, beside **About**: what it's spoken in and what its notes are written in. - **Transcription in the meeting's language:** a meeting is transcribed in the language it's spoken in (its own, its folder's, or Settings › Languages). Chinese is written in the script you choose, Cantonese in Traditional characters; **Detect automatically** finds the language and takes the one spoken longest. English transcribes exactly as before. - **Transcribe Again:** a meeting's 🌐 menu › **Transcribe Again in <language>…** transcribes it again from its audio; the old transcript goes to the Trash. - **AI writing languages:** meeting notes and follow-up emails can use their chosen languages; account summaries and other customer-wide writing follow the notes language setting or folder language. Quotes stay in the words spoken. - **On-device AI writing:** Fieldbook checks which languages Apple's on-device model supports. Use a Local model or Cloud endpoint for Japanese, or notes in a language different from the meeting's. - **Live transcript and Help Me Answer:** the live transcript follows the recording's language, including a change to the meeting's Spoken In during the call; with Detect automatically, it checks the language again as the call goes on. Help Me Answer and Suggest a Question write in its notes language. - **Search in other languages:** Chinese and Japanese words are found anywhere in a sentence, and Ask AI finds passages for questions asked in them. Meetings in other languages are matched as written, without English word forms. The search index is rebuilt once after updating. - **Questions during calls:** spot questions in other supported languages when **Questions during calls** is **In every language** (the default) in **Settings › Languages**.

**Fieldbook 2.4.5 beta 2** (a beta)
### Added - **Meeting header:** a button to open the meeting in its own window, beside **Find & Ask**; a **Transcript ready** line that says how many speakers still need a name (click it to open **Speakers**; it goes once all are named). - **Meeting list:** an **Add Files…** button between **Import** and **Sort**; **Merge…** beside **Move To** when several meetings are selected.
### Changed - **Meeting header:** the date is in the style's accent color, and an Unfiled meeting says, under its title, to move it to Internal or Partners before choosing the customers it's about. - **About customers:** on each item, the AI's customers are outlined pills and the ones you chose are filled, so you can tell them apart; several customers stack one per line. - **Licensing:** **Match Again** is always under a meeting's matched opportunities, so a match that came back empty or partial can be tried again.
### Fixed - **Licensing links** never read a page on this Mac or your local network, even when a public page links or redirects there; a link you add that is itself on your network is still read, and only that site. - **Licensing:** one large spreadsheet with many matching rows no longer crowds every other source out of an answer, and a company the question names is searched first. - **Licensing:** a match whose reply quotes far too much is asked again instead of slowing Fieldbook down. - **About customers:** a half-formed AI answer no longer marks an item as about no customer for good; the item is asked about again. - **About customers:** after you correct the transcript or your notes, labels that relied on the changed lines are made again, and every kept label is checked again against the meeting as it is now (for example, when a corrected line now switches to another customer). - **About customers** chosen, a rename, or **Move To** while a meeting records or transcribes can no longer be undone by the recording’s or transcription’s own save landing at the same moment. - **About menu:** counting how often each customer is named skips a very large transcript or notes file and never downloads a file kept only online. - **Opportunities › Copy as Table:** a cell starting with `=`, `+`, `-`, or `@` gets a leading `'`, so a spreadsheet shows it as text, never runs it as a formula.

**Fieldbook 2.4.5 beta 1** (a beta)
### Added - **An update that's waiting** shows in the menu-bar menu (**Install Update…**, with a dot on the icon) and at the top of **Settings › General › Updates** until you install or skip it, so a missed update window doesn't leave you on an old version. - **Update checks that keep failing** for three days (a hotel's network, or a firewall) say so in the same places, with **Check Now**. - **Support Fieldbook:** a new **Settings › Support** tab and **Help › Support Fieldbook…**, with **Buy Me a Coffee** and a link to join Fieldbook's Discord (or email, if Discord isn't an option); also **Help › Join the Discord…**. From 2.5 the same window opens by itself once per feature version, never in a beta and never while recording; it waits for a launch with nothing else to show, which may be a later one or a 2.x.y update. - **Your own opportunity stages:** selling for a company other than Zscaler, opportunities pick their stage from a list (Discovery, Qualification, Proposal, Negotiation, Closed Won, Closed Lost to start) that you edit in **Settings › General › Stages** or paste from your CRM. A Won or Lost stage closes the opportunity. Stages typed before stay as they are. - **Keep a Mac's meetings to itself:** on a Mac paired to read another Mac's meetings, **Settings › General › Another Mac › Offer this Mac's meetings** (on unless you turn it off). Off, the meetings you make there stay there; the other Mac's meetings still come. - **Set Up Fieldbook:** **Add Company…** to type in the company you work for, and, for a company other than Zscaler, steps for your opportunity stages and your discovery questions (the default questions, your own CSV, or none).
### Changed - **Follow-up email after AI notes** costs less with Claude through a gateway such as LiteLLM: it reuses the transcript Claude just read for the notes (prompt caching), as does a second try to fix citations. - **Help › Send a report** says to email diagnostic reports to fieldbook@ajawzero.com, and **Send feedback** points to the Discord first. - **Choosing a summary model uses it:** in **Settings › AI** and setup's AI step, picking a model (or typing one under **Other…** and pressing Return) tests it and uses it once it answers, so there's no **Verify and Use** to forget. If it doesn't answer, the message says which model is still in use; **Test Again** repeats the test. In setup, **Continue** tests a picked model first. - **General mode on a new Mac** no longer starts with Zscaler as your company: Set Up asks you to add yours, and until you do, the AI writes for "their company".
### Fixed - **Recording:** system audio that doesn't start within 20 seconds (a stuck screen capture) is recorded as missing instead of leaving Starting… on screen, and stopping no longer waits forever on one, so Saving… and Quit finish. - **Recording:** the Mac going to sleep while a recording is starting now stops it, as it does a recording already under way. - **Recording:** changing the output device with Direct no longer leaves a "System audio missing from 12:04 to 12:04" warning. - **Notes** typed just before quitting are saved; if they can't be (or can't be sent to the other Mac), Fieldbook asks before quitting. - **Fieldbook for iPhone:** a recording interrupted when iOS suspended Fieldbook picks the microphone up again on its own, instead of waiting for Resume. - **Fieldbook for iPhone:** a new name, notes, or Remove Audio that can't be saved now says so, and Remove Audio keeps the audio if the recording's details can't be updated. - **Changing the save location** now also moves a customer or label you deleted while it was in both the old and new locations, instead of leaving it in the old location's Trash. - **Another Mac:** a change the other Mac couldn't take (it may have been busy) can be sent again with **Send Again**, so notes typed here aren't lost. - **Another Mac:** a meeting the other Mac got another way keeps this Mac's copy, whatever Fieldbook version the other Mac has. - **Filing:** an invitee whose own address is listed in a folder files there, even when their company's domain belongs to another folder. - **Licensing links** on a site with its own port read that port's robots.txt. - **Leftover audio:** when a meeting's folder is deleted in Finder (or by another computer sharing the save location), **Settings › Storage › Leftover audio** lists the audio left behind, with **Move to Trash…**. - **Changing the save location away from a network share or drive with no macOS Trash** no longer leaves meetings in both places: **Settings › Storage** asks first, then deletes each old copy once its new copy is checked. - **Deleting a meeting** is refused, with a message, when the save location's Fieldbook Trash is a link to another folder, instead of the meeting disappearing. - **Call audio:** if Direct stops delivering audio partway through a call, Fieldbook moves the call side to screen capture after a minute, as it does when Direct records only silence. - **Remove All Fieldbook Data** now finds meetings filed under a customer's labels in a custom save location, and never moves the save-location folder itself to the Trash. - **Screen capture:** stopping a recording while system audio was restarting can no longer leave it capturing. - **Detect Speakers Again** keeps a new title given to the meeting while it ran. - **Saved voices:** if the saved voices file can't be read, naming a voice says so instead of saving over it. - **Another Mac:** a meeting you added from your other Mac stays on that Mac if you added attachments or new AI notes there after it was sent, instead of going to the Trash without them. - **Another Mac:** new meetings are offered before ones already answered, so older answers can't hold new ones back; a change made while a sync is running goes at once afterward; a move that couldn't be sent says so in **Settings › General › Another Mac**. - **Pairing another Mac by its key** works with many Fieldbook Macs nearby. - **A recording recovered after Fieldbook quit unexpectedly** keeps its microphone and call audio lined up. - **An import that stops partway** keeps the meetings that came in before it, transcribes them and writes their notes, and says how many there were. - **Opening a .zip** can no longer hang when the zip has many errors. - **A licensing link that redirects to another site** follows that site's robots.txt. - **Addresses with leading zeros** (such as 010.1.1.1) are no longer treated as on your network for plain HTTP. - **A model name the AI server doesn't have** now says so ("The endpoint doesn't have that model"), instead of saying the address has no chat completions. - **A received export with meetings from your other Mac:** the message lists those apart from meetings already here. - **Merge Meetings:** a recording made on Windows is labeled Windows, not Mac. - **Merge Meetings:** to-dos you changed keep their own identity in the merged meeting, so crossing off or editing one no longer changes another, and new AI notes can't cross off the wrong one. - **Merge Meetings:** a recording whose audio file is missing is refused instead of being merged with silence, and changes made to a recording while it merges are no longer lost: nothing is merged, and you merge again.

Offered to 1.8 and later as an automatic update, a small one from 2.4.3. Everything in the thirteen betas of 2.4.4: a second Mac that shows and changes your first Mac's meetings, Fieldbook's own Trash, a local AI model that runs inside Fieldbook, Fieldbook for Android, Combine with Recording…, Search in Settings, and many fixes.
### Added - **Another Mac's meetings:** pair a second Mac (**Settings › General › Another Mac › Pair…**, typing the code the first Mac shows in **File Transfers › Pair a Device…**), and it shows every meeting from the first Mac, with notes, AI notes, transcripts, and accounts, beside its own. Never audio or voices. They sync while Fieldbook is open on both, on the same network. A customer only the other Mac has opens with its account notes, summary, opportunities, MEDDPICC, and issues, marked **From <Mac>**. - **Change another Mac's meetings from this one:** your notes, titles, dates, folders, to-dos, and speaker names changed here go back to it at the next sync. The meeting says how many changes are waiting, and a small clock marks it in the list. If both Macs changed the same thing, notes and to-dos keep both; for the rest the other Mac keeps its own, and the meeting offers **Use Mine** or **Dismiss**. - **New meetings from your other Mac, when you add them:** meetings made there are listed on this Mac (**From Mac** in the toolbar, the Dock icon, the menu-bar menu, and File Transfers) with **Add**, **Not Now**, and **Don't Add**. Nothing joins your library by itself. Added meetings come without audio, filed where they were, and the other Mac moves its own copy to the Trash. - **Fieldbook's own Trash:** deleted meetings go to **Trash**, last under Library in the sidebar, instead of the macOS Trash. Each one shows its days left; **Put Back** returns it to its label or folder (or Unfiled if that's gone), and **⋯ › Delete Now** and **Empty Trash…** move items on to the macOS Trash. After 30 days they go there by themselves. In a save location two computers share, either computer's deleted items are listed, and changing the save location brings the Trash along. - **A local model that runs inside Fieldbook:** **Settings › AI › Local model › Runs in › Fieldbook (a downloaded model)** downloads a model once from Fieldbook's own releases on GitHub, checks every part before using it, and runs it on this Mac: no key, no other app, and nothing sent anywhere. Fieldbook recommends the one that suits your Mac's memory; Remove frees the space. - **Fieldbook for Android:** pair it with this Mac from **File Transfers › Pair a Device…** and it syncs like an iPhone: its recordings and notes come here, shown as from Android and filed in the folder chosen on the phone, and your last 90 days of meetings go to it. Recordings sent with Quick Share are imported by themselves when they land in **Downloads**. - **Combine with Recording…** joins a notes-only meeting to a recording of the same meeting by hand: notes sent from a phone with Quick Share or AirDrop, imported, or typed here. The notes go in under a heading naming where they were typed, and the notes-only meeting goes to the Trash. - **OpenAI as its own service:** **Settings › AI › Cloud endpoint › Service › OpenAI** needs only your OpenAI API key; the address is built in. - **Search in Settings:** a search bar at the top of Settings (**Command-F**) finds any setting by keyword. Matches list as tab and section, and clicking one opens it there, highlighted for a moment. - **Links from Help to Settings:** in Fieldbook Help, a reference such as **⚙ Settings › Modules** opens Settings at that tab and section, with Help still open beside it. - **Import several Discovery question files at once:** **Import CSV…** in **Settings › AI › Discovery Questions** takes more than one CSV, combined in the order you choose them. Help lists the columns (only **Question** is required) with an example file. - **No sound from the call yet:** with a call app using your microphone, if Fieldbook hears you for 15 seconds but nothing from the call, the Recorder says the call app may not be playing audio on this Mac (such as Teams with **Room audio** in a meeting room), so it can be fixed during the call. - **The Mac stays awake while Fieldbook records or transcribes:** an in-person meeting on battery no longer ends when the Mac's sleep timer runs out. The display can still go to sleep; closing the lid or choosing Sleep still sleeps the Mac. - **Help › Send Feedback…** opens an email to the developer with Fieldbook's version filled in. - **Help: Connecting Outlook or Google Calendar:** step by step, adding your work calendar to the Mac through System Settings › Internet Accounts, and what to do on a managed Mac.
### Changed - **A meeting's Opportunity and Issues** stand out under its title: each is a tinted tag in your style's color, with an icon, instead of faint grey text. - **Deleting a customer or label with meetings:** after asking, it moves to the Trash whole, with its meetings, labels, account notes, files, and emails, and **Put Back** returns it whole. Before, only empty ones could be deleted. - **Fewer repeated lines with your Mac's own microphone and speakers:** the call's words picked up by the microphone are left out of the transcript even when Whisper added "um", "yeah", or "okay" to them, so echo reduction can stay off. - **AI waits while you record with a model on this Mac:** with a downloaded model or a local server (Ollama, LM Studio), notes, Discovery, and other background AI work start after the recording ends, so the recording and the model don't compete for memory. Ask, Help Me Answer, Help, Licensing, and the pre-call brief still answer right away. - **To-dos in AI notes are split by action and person:** when someone promises two things, or two people each promise something, each gets its own to-do, owned by whoever will do it. - **Shorter AI settings:** under **Service**, one line says where meeting text goes; the full list is folded under **What's sent**. Each service's note is shorter too. - **zllama is filled in only for Zscaler:** a new setup leaves the Cloud endpoint empty unless the company you pick is Zscaler. Settings you already have don't change. - **Setup asks about you before AI notes,** so the AI step knows your company. - **File Transfers › Your Devices:** a Mac pairs here as well as an iPhone, iPad, or Android phone, so the button is now **Pair a Device…**, and **Settings › General › Sync with paired devices** turns it off. - **Speaker voice data** of a deleted meeting is kept while it's in Fieldbook's Trash, so a meeting put back still matches its speakers; it's deleted when the meeting leaves the Trash. - **Remove All Fieldbook Data** also removes downloaded AI models. - The Licensing page has a **How to add licensing documents** link that opens the steps in Help. - Fieldbook Help is up to date with Settings: the **Recording** (Call audio), **Paired Devices**, and **Another Mac** sections in General, **Live transcript** in Transcription, and which deletions go to Fieldbook's **Trash** and which to the macOS Trash. - Diagnostic and test launch options that record, transcribe, export, change data, or call the AI without a window now work only in development builds.
### Fixed - **Your API key only goes where you saved or tested it:** the endpoint in **Settings › AI** saves when you press Return, click **Test Connection**, or leave the field, not with every keystroke, and the key is tied to that address (host, port, and HTTPS or HTTP). A half-typed or changed endpoint can no longer receive the key from an AI job running in the background. If your endpoint has a port or uses HTTP, click **Test Connection** once after updating. - **Call audio stays on Direct after a quiet start:** an in-person meeting, or a call where nobody else speaks in the first minute, no longer changes the setting to Screen capture. It changes only when screen capture hears the call where Direct didn't. - **Back-to-back meetings:** a recording started in the last five minutes of one meeting, with the next about to begin, is named and filed as the next one. - A short reply of yours right after the other side spoke for a while is no longer removed from the transcript as echo. - A recording you start yourself no longer offers to stop, or stops, when an app set to **Ignore** in **Settings › Meetings**, or one that only briefly used the microphone, lets it go. - **A meeting's date** no longer fades almost out of sight while it's recording. - **Renaming or deleting a customer while the AI works on its account** (summary, conflicts check, status, next steps, MEDDPICC) no longer brings the old folder back; the result isn't saved and the message says so. - **Changing the save location** brings the reports for every customer along (Get to Green), keeping their dates. - **Separate** after a chain of Same Person As (A into B, then B into C) gives each speaker their own lines back, in either order. - In **General** mode, or with **Opportunities** off, account summaries, **Check for Conflicts**, and pre-call briefs no longer send the opportunity lines of meetings whose notes were written in Sales mode. The saved notes keep them. - In **General** mode, **Year in Review** groups what you did under general headings (**Wins and results**, **Projects**, **Team and enablement**, **Work with others**) instead of sales ones. - Renaming a folder by changing only its case (such as "pov" to "POV") can no longer lose the folder if Fieldbook quits partway. - A damaged or crafted zip file, or a caption or transcript file with an impossible time, no longer makes Fieldbook quit unexpectedly. - Quitting Fieldbook while a recording is still starting now stops it and quits, instead of waiting forever. - The menu-bar menu no longer says "Recording system audio only (microphone unavailable)" for every recording warning; it names a missing track, and otherwise points to the warning in Fieldbook. - An AI reply Fieldbook can't read now says "The reply wasn't valid JSON." instead of naming MEDDPICC for every feature. - Save Diagnostic Report no longer includes the AI's error text for notes that failed; the activity log keeps the reason.

Offered to 1.8 and later as an automatic update, a small one from 2.4.2. Everything in the four betas of 2.4.3: echo reduction off by default, Search on its own page, Find & Ask in a meeting, Join and Record from Today, better titles and transcripts, and Meeting Time that can count meetings you accepted.
### Added - **Join and Record:** in Today, Join's arrow (and the right-click menu) offers **Join and Record**: it opens the meeting link and starts recording, named and filed from the invite, in one click. - **Better titles without a calendar event:** a meeting named "Meeting", "Zoom call", or "Notes" and the date gets a short title from its first AI notes, such as "Contoso pricing review", in the same AI request. Titles you typed and calendar titles are never changed. - **"This meeting looks over"**: when a recording linked to a calendar event has no call app to follow, Fieldbook asks once whether to stop when the event ended 5 minutes ago and both sides have been quiet for a minute. It never stops on its own. - **Is this the other invitee?** In a 1:1, when one person on the call side is still unnamed and only one invitee is left, Fieldbook offers that invitee's name with Yes and No. - **Help and Settings in the sidebar:** at the bottom, under My To-dos, as in Fieldbook for Windows. - **Help: your calendar through a private iCal link**, for when your company won't let you add your work account to this Mac.
### Changed - **Echo reduction is off by default:** with it on, some call apps (Teams in a browser, for one) could hear you much more quietly. If you picked a setting before, it's kept. Turn it on in the Recorder's microphone menu or Settings › General › Microphone. - **Search has its own page:** click **Search** in the sidebar, above Library, or press Shift-Command-F. One big box finds words in your meetings as you type and asks AI when you press Return, with a menu to search one folder and a switch to include the archive. Your recent questions are under it. The search field and the **Ask** button are gone from the toolbar. - **Find & Ask in a meeting:** the new magnifying-glass button at the top right of a meeting (or Command-F) opens a column that lists the meeting's lines matching what you type, and asks AI about the meeting when you press Return. - **Opportunity and Issues** are higher in a meeting's header, under its folder and above the date, where they're easier to see. - **Meeting Time counts meetings you accepted but didn't record:** the setting is now **Count accepted meetings you didn't record** (Settings › Meetings › Calendars). With it on, a meeting you accepted or organized counts even without a recording, with the invite's length; a tentative invite counts only when you record it, import it, or add notes. Each week in Meeting Time says how many it has that you didn't record, marks them **accepted · not recorded**, and has **Add Notes…** beside each. - **Transcripts:** company names of a meeting's invitees (from their email addresses) are spelled right more often, and Whisper's stray “Subtitles by…” and “Thanks for watching” lines are left out where nobody was speaking. - **Ask AI:** answers from small and local models no longer show leaked reasoning, “Based on the provided sources” openings, or a pile of citations in one group. - **New calendar events show sooner:** Fieldbook asks macOS to sync your calendars before reading them, at most once a minute. - **Your iPhone and iPad use your fiscal year:** the fiscal year start you set on the Mac now syncs, so quarters on the iPhone and iPad match the Mac's.
### Fixed - **Update All:** checks what’s out of date in the background, so the app no longer pauses on a library in a synced folder such as Google Drive. - **Issues:** the page responds quickly while typing, opening issues, and changing severity or status. - **Speakers:** names no longer get cut off on a narrow page; status moves under the name.

Offered to 1.8 and later as an automatic update, a small one from 2.4.1. Everything in the six betas of 2.4.2: import recordings from other recorders and calls, hear a speaker before naming them, tag a meeting with its opportunity and issues while you record, Meeting Time that counts the meetings you attended, and update checks that try again.
### Added - **Import recordings:** the **Import** button and **File › Import Recording or Transcript…** now take audio and video files (MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, AIFF, FLAC, CAF, MP4, MOV, M4V), such as recordings from Plaud, Pocket, and other recorders, or Zoom and Teams recordings. Each becomes a meeting, transcribed on your Mac with its speakers found, like your own recordings. Only the sound is kept. You can also drag them into Fieldbook, onto a folder, or use **File › Add Files…**. - **Offer to add audio and video you download** (Settings › General › Downloads and Email Folder): an audio or video file you download or AirDrop while Fieldbook is open asks where it goes, as a downloaded email does. Nothing is added without asking. - **Hear who a speaker is before naming them:** click a speaker's name and **Listen** plays one of their paragraphs, then stops; the arrows go to their others. **Show All** opens a find bar under the player that steps through everything they said in the transcript, marked in their color, with **Play** and **Name…**.
### Changed - **Tag a meeting while you record:** the **Opportunity** and **Issues** menus are at the top of the meeting, under its date, so you can tag a customer call with its opportunity and issues during the call. They used to appear beside the **Brief** only once the AI notes were written. - **Meeting Time counts the meetings you attended:** the ones you recorded, imported, or took notes for, in every week and year, past ones included. Your calendar still files and times them. To also count calendar meetings you didn't record, as before, turn on **Count calendar meetings you didn't record** in **Settings › Meetings › Calendars**. - **Recordings from your iPhone or iPad, and imported recordings:** nobody is labeled you any more, since the person who talks most isn't always you. Name yourself like anyone else; with **Remember this voice**, Fieldbook recognizes you in later ones. Recordings made on your Mac are unchanged. - **Importing a recording** refuses a file whose sound is kept in other files it points to (a QuickTime reference movie): Fieldbook reads only the file you chose. Export it as one file, such as MP4 or M4A, and import that. - **Ask about one meeting:** the question field is at the top of the column, under its title, and ready to type in as soon as the column opens. Follow-ups go in the same field, and each new answer scrolls into view. - **Search:** the results start with **Results for “…”** and an **✕** that closes the search and brings back the folder's meetings. Esc does the same.
### Fixed - **Updates:** when the daily update check can't reach the update server, for example because your Mac just woke and isn't back on the network yet, it now tries again up to three times, an hour apart. It used to wait a whole day. - **Meeting lists:** in **All Meetings**, **Archive**, and a customer's **Also about**, a meeting's folder path always shows in full and a long title is cut off at its end, instead of drawing over other text. A customer whose only meetings are under **Also about** no longer shows "No meetings here" over one of them. - **Pre-call briefs:** when a recording is switched to another meeting at the same time, it no longer keeps the first meeting's brief (with that customer's agenda, invitees, and history). It gets the other meeting's brief instead, if there is one. The first meeting's brief stays ready for that meeting. - **View › Show Source Times** (Option-Command-T) now works at the standard text size; it was greyed out unless the text was bigger or smaller, and **Actual Size** wasn't greyed out at actual size. - **Diagnostics:** an alert left open, such as "An error occurred in retrieving update information", is no longer logged as the app not responding.
